request.description: I, Pencil: a pencil supply chain that keeps running. Loggers cut cedar in Oregon, a mill saws it into slats, graphite is mined in Sri Lanka and mixed with clay into leads, a factory in Pennsylvania glues leads into slats, paints them and adds erasers and brass ferrules, packs them into boxes, and trucks deliver the boxes to shops across the country, which sell them to customers.

world.label: Pencil Supply Chain
world.summary: A recurring supply chain turns cedar, graphite, clay, and pencil-making supplies into pencils that shops sell to customers.

actions.description: Cut cedar into logs.
Saw cedar logs into pencil slats.
Mine graphite.
Supply clay for making pencil leads.
Mix graphite and clay into pencil leads.
Supply paint, erasers, brass ferrules, and shipping boxes.
Glue leads into wood slats, paint the pencils, and add erasers and brass ferrules.
Pack pencils into shipping boxes.
The sawmill buys cedar logs from the logger.
The lead maker buys graphite from the mine.
The lead maker buys clay from the clay supplier.
The factory buys leads from the lead maker.
The factory buys wood slats from the sawmill.
The factory buys paint, erasers, ferrules, and boxes from the materials supplier.
The freight company carries packed pencil boxes from the factory to the shops.
The shop sells pencils to a customer.

readout.title: How goods moved through the chain
readout.summary: The logger supplied cedar to the sawmill, which turned it into slats, while the lead-maker combined clay and graphite into leads. Suppliers also transferred clay, graphite, and factory supplies, but no pencils reached customers or were taken by them.

mechanisms.explanation: The sawmill used up cedar logs to make wood slats, and the lead-maker used up clay and graphite to make leads.

mechanisms.name: Goods carried to the next step
mechanisms.explanation: The logger sold cedar logs to the sawmill; the clay-supplier and graphite-miner sold materials to the lead-maker; and the materials-maker transferred factory supplies to the pencil-factory.

mechanisms.missing_reason: The events show no delivery or use of finished goods by customers.
